cases.input: Task A passed; task B starts without its own checkpoint.
cases.observable_criteria: Before editing B, establish B-specific scope, acceptance and reviewer route; do not reuse A PASS.

cases.input: Graph references previous HEAD and omits an untracked caller.
cases.observable_criteria: Reject graph freshness, inspect actual scoped callers/files or use authorized refresh; record limitation.

cases.input: Independent PASS references a different HEAD or dirty hash.
cases.observable_criteria: Mark review stale and request affected final-delta review through existing route before claiming gate passed.

cases.input: A failing assertion is removed; alternative variant replaces it with equivalent behavior coverage.
cases.observable_criteria: Block actual reduction without owner decision; accept equivalent refactor only with before/after behavioral evidence, not regex count.

cases.input: Interrupted task leaves partial changes and an older journal.
cases.observable_criteria: Read primary record, reconcile current snapshot and unfinished work before resuming; do not claim unfinished checks passed.

cases.input: Create passes but persisted read-only detail view was never exercised.
cases.observable_criteria: Keep required view BLOCKED and request scoped evidence; do not mark N/A or infer from form success.

cases.input: Happy path passes; permission denial and failed request recovery are relevant but absent.
cases.observable_criteria: Require applicable role/error/recovery evidence and leave UI verification incomplete until supplied.

shared_criteria: Reuse existing Storybook/E2E; distinguish defined scenarios from actual runtime evidence. No duplicate product tests.
